text: The authors find all debaters have an Elo advantage when assigned the correct answer. However, compared to Khan et al. they do not see as clear a trend of this advantage increasing with aggregate Elo; on extractive tasks it appears to get slightly easier for honest debaters as models increase their convincingness, whereas on closed tasks there is less of a clear trend.
title: The authors see a correct-answer advantage but not Khan et al.'s clear growth with debater Elo
